name: lucas-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Lucas Saldanha Werneck: verification guards, session tools, web and desktop helpers.

plugins.name: handoff-terminal
plugins.description: When the Claude desktop app refuses a sign-in or personal-data step in the browser, a hidden terminal session does it and hands the result back.

plugins.name: op-secrets
plugins.description: Save and load secrets through 1Password without the values ever entering the chat.

plugins.name: assumptions-pane
plugins.description: A side pane where Claude logs every assumption it makes, so you can confirm or correct it with a click.

plugins.name: save-clear
plugins.description: Save decisions and next steps to a snapshot, clear the session, and resume from the snapshot in the next one.

plugins.name: give-up-guard
plugins.description: Stop hook: when Claude ends with 'I didn't check X', hands the task back or asks you for data, it is sent back to check first.

plugins.name: wait-loop-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Bash wait loops (until/while) that have no deadline, so Claude can't hang forever.

plugins.name: web-unlock-guard
plugins.description: Guards web scraping: stop retrying a failing method, no headless browser on Cloudflare pages, no debug port without a separate profile.
